blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction, and only relies on posed street and satellite views. Our experiments on outdoor datasets show that our model is better than both satellite-conditioned or street-view conditioned baselines on novel-view synthesis, especially on challenging cases where target views have very little overlap with source views. Project page: https://nianticspatial.github.io/groundcontrol
blocks.zh: 多视图或视频传播模式最近已出现,成为从稀少的图像集中进行小说-视图合成的最先进的方法. 虽然它们能产生出高品质的图像,但是在合成输入视图以外的视图(场景外推法)时,往往会产生不切实际的空间布局的幻觉. 我们建议利用卫星图像作为补充信息来源,为多视角基因模型创造条件,以应对户外场景的这一挑战。 我们采用了一个新的卫星条件多视图传播模型,在生成新颖视图时,将卫星图像中的调制和街道层面的输入图像结合起来。 我们的跨视取材条件使我们能够保留预先训练的多视传播前科,从少数来源视图中产生出无缝,现实,新颖的观点,同时坚持从卫星图像中看到的场景布局. 我们的模型不使用3D场景重建,而只依赖于被设置的街道和卫星视图. 我们户外数据集的实验表明,我们的模型比卫星条件或街景条件的基线在新视角综合上都要好,特别是在目标观点与源观点几乎没有重叠的具有挑战性的案件中。 项目网页:https://nianticspatial.github.io/地控

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Imagine looking at a photo of a street, e.g . Fig 1 .
Given just that photo, could you realistically picture what is on either side of the street?
Current generative models for novel-view synthesis ( e.g . video models [ 29 , 27 , 28 , 9 ] or camera-controlled diffusion models [ 3 , 22 ] ) can extrapolate scenes from sparse input views, but they hallucinate outside the input views, generating buildings and roads that may not exist. But what if you also had a satellite image?
The satellite view provides a good spatial layout prior, although it gives you a limited sense of appearance, e.g . the satellite view may not see the facades of buildings and the appearance of smaller objects.
The street image and the satellite image are both useful, but incomplete. In this work, we fuse the best of both: we introduce a generative model that uses the satellite image as a strong spatial prior to guide ground-level multi-view novel-view synthesis, allowing us to generate new, photorealistic views that adhere to the satellite layout and to the content of street-level photos.
blocks.zh:
想象一下看街道的照片,例如图1.
就那张照片 你能现实地想象一下街上两边有什么吗?
目前用于小说-视觉合成的基因模型(例如视频模型[29,27,28,9]或相机控制的传播模型[3,22])可以从稀疏的输入视图中推断出场景,但它们会在输入视图之外产生幻觉,产生可能不存在的建筑物和道路. 但如果你也有卫星图像呢?
卫星视野在之前提供了良好的空间布局,虽然它给了你有限的外观感,例如. 卫星视图可能看不到建筑物的外观和较小物体的外观。
街道图像和卫星图像都是有用的,但不完整. 在这项工作中,我们把两者中的最好部分融为一体:我们引入了一种基因模型,在引导地面多景小说-视觉合成之前,先将卫星图像作为强大的空间,使我们能够产生新的、光现实主义的观点,坚持卫星布局和街道照片的内容。

blocks.en:
While there is extensive work on generating ground-level images or panoramas from satellite images alone (Table 1 ), [ 71 , 81 , 38 , 72 ] , doing this without any ground-level information is a highly challenging task. Many such works rely on oblique aerial or satellite imagery, where the facade of buildings (and hence street-level textures and geometry) are captured [ 72 , 71 , 19 , 37 ] . They struggle with the more common orthographic satellite images which give very limited information about ground-level aesthetics that can only be inferred from street-level source views.
Furthermore, in applications where sparse ground-level images are available, it is unclear how these methods can be leveraged to complete such partially observed ground-scenes.
It is therefore appealing to combine satellite images for layout-guidance together with sparse street-level views to generate street-views with accurate textures and appearance.
blocks.zh:
尽管在从卫星图像中生成地面图像或全景方面开展了大量工作(表1),[71、81、38、72],但是在没有任何地面信息的情况下开展这项工作是一项极具挑战性的任务。 许多这类工程依靠斜面的空中或卫星图象,在这些图象中,建筑物的外观(因而是街道的纹理和几何)被捕获[72、71、19、37]。 它们与较常见的正体卫星图象相冲突,这些图象提供的地面美学信息非常有限,只能从街道一级的原始观点推断出来。
此外,在地面图像稀少的应用中,尚不清楚如何利用这些方法完成这种部分观测到的地面场景。
因此,有必要将卫星图像与稀少的街道景观结合起来,进行布局指导,以产生有准确纹理和外观的街道景观。

blocks.en: Text-to-image diffusion models learn a rich image generative prior from large datasets which has been leveraged in many controlled-generation settings, by conditioning on various modalities [ 47 , 80 , 49 , 5 ] . However, the combination of multi-view and satellite images poses unique challenges to these conditioning methods due to stark differences in the appearance and viewpoints between them. To this end, we introduce a novel satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model for outdoor scenes. By finetuning only our newly added lightweight ray-guided cross-attention layers, we retain the rich multi-view generative priors of the diffusion model. Our approach is reconstruction-free, as in does not assume access to satellite height maps or street-level 3D scene reconstructions or pixel-accurate 6DoF street view-satellite alignment. It only requires relative camera poses and coarse 3DoF (X, Y, heading) satellite alignment. We demonstrate our model’s effectiveness across a range of different datasets, from domains including self-driving car data, street-level panoramas, and sparse collections of images from hand held cameras.
blocks.zh: 文本到图像传播模型先从大型数据集中学习到丰富的图像基因,这些数据集在许多可控生成环境中被利用,其方法是利用各种方式[47、80、49、5]。 然而,多视图图象和卫星图像的结合对这些调制方法构成了独特的挑战,因为两者的外观和观点存在明显的差异. 为此,我们为户外场景引入了新型卫星条件多景传播模式. 通过微调我们新添加的轻量级射线导线跨视层,我们保留了扩散模型丰富的多视角遗传学前科。 我们的方法是无重建的,因为其中不假定可以获得卫星高度图或街道三级立体场景重建或像素精确6DoF街景卫星对接。 它只需要相对相机姿势和粗细的3DoF (X,Y,标题) 卫星对齐. 我们展示了我们模型在一系列不同数据集中的有效性,这些数据集包括自驾汽车数据、街头全景以及手持相机图像的零星收集。

blocks.en: In summary, our key contributions are:
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en: • We introduce a satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model GroundControl for novel view synthesis of street scenes. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first satellite-guided multi-view generation approach that does not use height-maps or street-level reconstruction. • We adopt a ray-guided cross-attention method for conditioning state-of-the-art camera controlled diffusion models on 2D satellite image features. Our approach is efficient as it only trains the new cross-attention parameters we add, and on a relatively small dataset. • Our experiments on diverse datasets show that GroundControl can generate novel views that adhere to the spatial layout of the satellite view, while retaining the multi-view consistency and generative prior of the diffusion model.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们采用了卫星条件的多景传播模型 地面控制 用于新颖的景观综合 街道场景。 据我们所知,这是第一种不使用高度图或街道级重建的卫星制导多视图生成方法。 我们采用射线制导的交叉视距方法,在二维卫星成像特征上对最先进的相机控制传播模型进行调节。 我们的方法是有效的,因为它只训练我们增加的新的交叉注意参数,以及比较小的数据集。 • 支助 我们对各种数据集的实验表明,地面控制可以产生符合卫星视图空间布局的新观点,同时保留多视图一致性和传承模型之前的基因。

blocks.en: We introduce a satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model GroundControl for novel view synthesis of street scenes. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first satellite-guided multi-view generation approach that does not use height-maps or street-level reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 我们采用了卫星条件的多景传播模型 地面控制 用于新颖的景观综合 街道场景。 据我们所知,这是第一种卫星制导的多视图生成方法,不使用高度图或街道级重建。

blocks.en: We adopt a ray-guided cross-attention method for conditioning state-of-the-art camera controlled diffusion models on 2D satellite image features. Our approach is efficient as it only trains the new cross-attention parameters we add, and on a relatively small dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们采用射线制导的交叉视距方法,在二维卫星成像特征上对最先进的相机控制传播模型进行调节。 我们的方法是有效的,因为它只训练我们增加的新的交叉注意参数,以及比较小的数据集。

blocks.en: Our experiments on diverse datasets show that GroundControl can generate novel views that adhere to the spatial layout of the satellite view, while retaining the multi-view consistency and generative prior of the diffusion model.
blocks.zh: 我们对各种数据集的实验表明,地面控制可以产生符合卫星视图空间布局的新观点,同时保留多视图一致性和传承模型之前的基因。

blocks.en: 2.1 Satellite-to-Street Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 卫星对街头生成

blocks.en:
Street view generation from oblique satellite and aerial views. These works typically use oblique multi-view satellite imagery to generate a coarse scene geometry, to which visible texture (color) is applied from satellite images.
This coarse reconstruction is then rendered from street-level viewpoints and subsequently refined by a dedicated network.
For example, [ 72 , 71 ] use a coarse textured mesh; [ 19 ] use a 3D Gaussian Splat [ 31 ] ; [ 37 ] use a voxel-based representation;
and AerialGo [ 81 ] use a 3D point representation
similar to [ 19 ] .
Skyfall-GS [ 35 ] also generates splats from multi-view satellite images, but unlike [ 19 ] they improve the Gaussian splats themselves.
Unlike these approaches, our method has no restrictions on the types of satellite views it can use as conditioning signal.
blocks.zh:
街景来自斜视卫星和空中视角. 这些作品一般使用斜面多视的卫星图像生成粗糙的场景几何,从卫星图像中将可见纹理(颜色)应用到此.
这种粗糙的重建随后从街道一级的观点出发,然后由一个专门的网络加以完善。
例如,[72,71]使用粗质的纹理网格;[19]使用3D Gaussian Splat [31];[37]使用以阴道为基础的代表;
和 AirGo [81] 使用三维点表示符
类似[19].
Skyfall-GS [35] 也从多视图卫星图像中生成浮标,但与[19]不同的是,它们改进了高斯浮标本身.
与这些方法不同,我们的方法对它能用作调制信号的卫星视线类型没有限制.

blocks.en:
Street view generation from orthorectified satellite views. Methods that use orthorectified (“top-down”) satellite inputs are more general, they can generate appearance of invisible building facades (without oblique imagery).
Many of these methods still rely on intermediate representations: Sat2Density [ 50 ] estimates volume density, Sat2Scene [ 39 ] estimates a noisy 3D point cloud and denoises it via diffusion, Sat2Vid [ 38 ] estimates a semantically labeled point cloud, [ 63 ] uses a polar warp, [ 37 ] uses street-level voxelized geometry, and other methods estimate depth [ 43 , 59 ] . More recent works Sat2Density++ [ 51 ] and SatDreamer360 [ 79 ] use ray-guided cross-attention with intermediate triplane representations. These intermediate representations lack data for large-scale supervision, and can create a quality bottleneck as they introduce artifacts downstream. Other works directly map satellite views to ground-level images using GANs [ 53 , 69 , 73 , 4 , 20 , 83 , 54 ] . StreetScapes [ 11 ] synthesizes street-level videos from semantic maps and height maps (without true satellite images). Other work generates fully synthetic worlds, sometimes via generated top-down views [ 40 ] .
blocks.zh:
街景生成来自矫形卫星视图. 使用矫形(“自上而下”)卫星投入的方法较为普遍,可以产生无形建筑外观(没有斜面图像)。
其中许多方法仍然依靠中间表述: Sat2Density [50] 估计体积密度,Sat2Scene [39] 估计出一个吵闹的三维点云,并通过扩散使其暴露;Sat2Vid [38] 估计出一个标注的点云,[63] 使用极曲面,[37] 使用街道一级氧化几何,其他方法估计出深度[43,59]. 较近的作品Sat2Density++[51]和SatDreamer360[79]使用射线导交叉视线,中间的绊线表示. 这些中间代表物缺乏大规模监督的数据,在下游引进文物时可能形成质量瓶颈. 其他作品直接将卫星视图映射到使用GANs的地面图像[53,69,73,4,20,83,54]. StreetScapes [11] 合成来自语义地图和高度图(没有真实的卫星图像)的街道级视频. 其他作品产生完全合成的世界,有时通过生成的自上而下视图[40].

blocks.en: Our method is the first to directly condition a multi-view generation model on satellite images without any intermediate representations or supervision. It is closely related to [ 79 , 78 ] . SatDreamer360 [ 79 ] uses an intermediate triplane representation. It also requires panorama sequences, while ours is trained on multi-view images that are more available. [ 78 ] uses a street-to-satellite transformation similar to ours, but their “attention” model is actually a height-distribution prediction, not street-to-satellite attention. It also does not allow conditioning on street-view images (only text input).
blocks.zh: 我们的方法是首先在卫星图像上直接规定多视图生成模型的条件,而没有任何中间表示或监督。 它与[79,78]密切相关. SatDreamer360 [79] 使用中间绊线表示. 它还需要全景序列,而我们的图像则接受更多可用多视图图像的培训. [78] 采用了与我们相似的街对卫星转换,但其“注意”模型实际上是高度分布预测,而不是街对卫星的注意。 它也不允许对街景图像(只允许文本输入)进行配置.

blocks.en:
Other tasks with satellite and street-level data. Other works combine satellite and ground-level views for related tasks. For example, [ 68 ] uses ground-level images to improve satellite segmentation, and Horizon-GS [ 30 ] combines satellite and street-level inputs for splatting.
Ye et al . [ 74 ] address the inverse setting by synthesizing satellite views from street images.
Feng et al . [ 13 ] use GPS as a conditioning signal for image generation, but primarily to guide high-level semantics rather than accurate scene structure.
blocks.zh:
其他有卫星和街道级数据的任务. 其他作品将卫星和地面观测结合起来,执行相关任务。 例如,[68]利用地面图像改进卫星分区,Horizon-GS[30]将卫星和街道层面的投入结合起来进行镀层。
Ye et al. [74] 通过合成街道图像中的卫星视图来应对逆向设置。
Feng et al. [13] 使用GPS作为图像生成的调节信号,但主要用于引导高层次语义而非准确的场景结构.

blocks.en: 2.2 Novel-view Synthesis and Multi-View Diffusion
blocks.zh: 2.2 小说视图合成和多维传播

blocks.en:
Novel view synthesis (NVS) from one or more posed input images has a long history.
Classical methods used image-based rendering with geometry proxies to warp input pixels [ 10 , 60 , 24 ] .
With deep learning, DeepStereo [ 17 ] used a network to select pixels from posed input views, while [ 82 ] learned to warp input-view pixels.
Another line of work directly renders explicit 3D scene representations [ 31 , 1 ] .
blocks.zh:
一个或一个以上设置的输入图像的小说视图合成(NVS)有着悠久的历史.
古典方法使用基于图像的渲染,带有几何代数,用于曲速输入像素[10,60,24].
随着深度的学习,DeepStereo [17] 使用网络从已提出的输入视图中选择像素,而[82] 学习了曲速输入-视图像素.
另一行工作直接使立体场景表现清晰 [31, 1].

blocks.en:
More recently, conditional diffusion models have unlocked direct generation of realistic target views [ 42 ] .
Works like CAT3D [ 18 ] , EscherNet [ 34 ] , MultiDiff [ 48 ] , PolyOculus [ 76 ] and [ 66 , 56 ] implicitly learn multi-view consistency using ray-based positional encodings [ 46 ] , which are now common in novel-view synthesis.
SEVA [ 3 ] and MVGD [ 22 ] further improved temporal consistency by training on fixed-length sequences [ 3 ] and performing multi-view diffusion jointly rather than sequentially [ 22 ] . WildCAT3D [ 2 ] further extended this to in-the-wild images.
A key benefit of these approaches is easier scene extrapolation, but they can hallucinate incorrect layouts and semantic artifacts, even when outputs appear plausible.
An alternative line of work generates video from images without camera control [ 29 , 27 , 28 , 9 ] ; we consider camera control to be important for interactive real-world interfaces.
Our work builds on the SEVA [ 3 ] backbone approach for novel view synthesis, and our innovations enable the injection of additional priors from satellite views.
blocks.zh:
最近,有条件的传播模式解锁了直接生成现实的目标观点[42].
作品如CAT3D [18],EscherNet [34],MultiDiff [48],PolyOculus [76]和[66,56] 使用以射线为基础的位置编码来隐含地学习多视图一致性[46],这在小说-观点合成中现在很常见.
SEVA[3]和MVGD[22]通过对固定长度序列的培训[3]和联合进行而不是相继进行多视传播[22],进一步提高了时间一致性. WildCAT3D[2]进一步将这一范围扩展至浑浊的图像.
这些方法的一个关键好处是更方便的场景外推,但即使产出似乎合理,它们也会产生不正确的布局和语义文物的幻觉.
另一条工作线从没有相机控制的图像生成视频[29, 27, 28, 9];我们认为相机控制对于交互式现实世界界面很重要.
我们的工作以SEVA[3]的骨干方法为基础,进行新颖的景观合成,我们的革新使得能够从卫星观点注入更多的前科。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We propose an efficient approach to condition a pretrained camera-controlled multi-view diffusion model on satellite imagery. We extend the widely accepted UNet-based diffusion model architecture for satellite view conditioning by adding ray-guided cross attention parameters between the diffusion embeddings and satellite embeddings from a pretrained satellite encoder. This allows us to leverage both pretrained multi-view diffusion priors as well as pretrained satellite encoders, reducing the need for large numbers of sequence-and-satellite training data. We first provide a brief background on multi-view diffusion models in Section 3.1 , then explain the satellite conditional generation approach in Section 3.2 and the ray-guided cross-attention in Section 3.3 . Our training details are discussed in Section 3.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们建议采取一种有效的方法,在卫星图像上建立一个预先训练好的摄像机控制的多视差传播模型。 我们从预先训练的卫星编码器上,在扩散嵌入物和卫星嵌入物之间增加射线制导的交叉注意力参数,从而扩展了普遍接受的基于UNet的卫星观测条件传播模型结构。 这使我们能够利用预先培训的多视图传播前科和预先培训的卫星编码器,从而减少大量序列和卫星培训数据的需求。 我们首先在第3.1节中简要介绍多视图传播模型,然后在第3.2节中解释卫星有条件生成方法,在第3.3节中解释射线制导的交叉注意。 第3.4节讨论了我们的训练细节。

blocks.en: 3.1 Multi-view Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 多视传播模式

blocks.en:
Text-conditioned image diffusion models generate an image 𝐱 \mathbf{x} from text conditions 𝒯 \mathcal{T} by iteratively denoising an initial noise sample ϵ \epsilon in T T timesteps. They are probabilistic models that sample from the distribution of images conditioned on text 𝒫 ⁡ ( 𝐱 | 𝒯 ) \mathcal{P}(\mathbf{x}|\mathcal{T}) .
Camera-controlled multi-view diffusion models [ 3 , 22 ] extend this generative prior to N N views, with added conditioning on camera poses and intrinsic parameters.
Given a set of input images 𝒳 inp \mathcal{X}^{\text{inp}} and their camera parameters 𝒞 inp \mathcal{C}^{\text{inp}} , they generate a set of target views 𝒳 tgt \mathcal{X}^{\text{tgt}} for the queried target cameras 𝒞 tgt \mathcal{C}^{\text{tgt}} . Probabilistically, they sample from the distribution 𝒫 ⁡ ( 𝒳 tgt | 𝒳 inp , 𝒞 inp , 𝒞 tgt ) \mathcal{P}(\mathcal{X}^{\text{tgt}}|\mathcal{X}^{\text{inp}},\mathcal{C}^{\text{inp}},\mathcal{C}^{\text{tgt}}) .

3.2 GroundControl: Satellite-conditioned Multi-view Diffusion
blocks.zh: 3.2 地面控制:卫星条件下的多视扩散

blocks.en:
We introduce a satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model GroundControl, that samples from the conditional distribution 𝒫 ⁡ ( 𝒳 tgt ∣ 𝒳 inp , 𝒞 inp , 𝒞 tgt , S ) \mathcal{P}(\mathcal{X}^{\text{tgt}}\mid\mathcal{X}^{\text{inp}},\mathcal{C}^{\text{inp}},\mathcal{C}^{\text{tgt}},S) .
Here, S S is the satellite image captured at roughly the same location as { 𝒞 inp , 𝒞 tgt } \{\mathcal{C}^{\text{inp}},\mathcal{C}^{\text{tgt}}\} . Effectively Conditioning on satellite images S S is non-trivial.
The design choices in GroundControl follow two main principles. First, we retain the multi-view generative prior 𝒫 ⁡ ( 𝒳 tgt ∣ 𝒳 inp , 𝒞 inp , 𝒞 tgt ) \mathcal{P}(\mathcal{X}^{\text{tgt}}\mid\mathcal{X}^{\text{inp}},\mathcal{C}^{\text{inp}},\mathcal{C}^{\text{tgt}}) of the pretrained model while increasing the likelihood of samples that adhere to the satellite image condition S S . Second, we use specialized parameters for satellite images because their semantics differ substantially from those of street-level images.

我们引入了卫星条件多视图传播模式 Ground Control,即来自有条件分布的样本 P\\(X tgt → X inp, Cinp, C tgt, S)\ mathcal{P} (\ mathcal\ text{ tgt\ mathcal\\ text{ inp\,\ mathcal{ intext{, \ mathcal{ tgt} S) 。 。 。
这里, S S 是和 { C inp, C tgt }\ mathcal{ C}\\ text{inp}},\ mathcal{ C}\ text{ tgt}}\}} 大致相同的卫星图像。 有效附着卫星图像S S是非三角性的.
地面控制的设计选择遵循两个主要原则。 首先,我们保留预先训练过的模型的多视图基因XQ(X tgt X inp, C inp, C tgt)\ mathcal{P}(\mathcal__tgt_mid\mathcal_text{inp_,\mathcal{inp_,\mathcal{inp_,\mathcal{c}^{\text{t_tgt}),同时增加符合卫星图像条件S的样本的可能性. 第二,我们对卫星图像使用专门参数,因为它们的语义与街头图像的语义大不相同。

blocks.en:
Hence, GroundControl is finetuned from a multi-view diffusion model [ 3 ] , which provides the rich generative multi-view prior from large-scale pretraining on posed images.
Our key contribution is to add residual cross-attention layers to incorporate the satellite conditioning signal into the diffusion model.
In particular, the residual cross-attention layers contain a zero-initialized linear output layer which ensures that the multi-view diffusion prior is retained at the start of training. Motivated by our second design principle, we encode satellite images with DINOv3 [ 61 ] . Our street-level multi-view input images are encoded by the diffusion model itself, alongside the noisy target images.
This allows us to condition the multi-view diffusion model on generalizable satellite embeddings, much like the CLIP text embeddings used in text-to-image diffusion models [ 52 ] .
blocks.zh:
因此,地面控制从一个多视图传播模型[3]中微调出来,该模型提供了丰富的基因多视角,先于对所展示的图像进行大规模预先训练。
我们的主要贡献是增加残余的交叉注意层,将卫星调节信号纳入扩散模型。
特别是,残余的交叉观察层包含一个零初始线性输出层,确保培训开始时保留之前的多视图传播。 以我们的第二个设计原则为动力,我们用DINov3编码卫星图像。 我们的街道层面多视图输入图像由传播模型本身编码,与吵闹的目标图像并列.
这使得我们可以将多视图传播模型以通用卫星嵌入为条件,这与文本到图像传播模型中使用的CLIP文本嵌入非常类似[52].

blocks.en:
Conditioning on a satellite image assumes that the multi-view images are geolocalized.
In particular, we assume known metric relative poses between views and approximate latitude, longitude and planar orientation of one of the views.
This allows us to localize each camera with a 2D translation and 1D orientation in the satellite image.
blocks.zh:
在卫星图像上的条件假设多视图图像是地理定位的。
特别是,我们假定一种观点与大致纬度、经度和规划方向之间已知的尺度相对关系。
这使得我们能将每台相机本地化,在卫星图像中有一个2D翻译和1D定向.

blocks.en: 3.3 Ray-guided Cross Attention
blocks.zh: 3.3 光导交叉注意

blocks.en:
An effective way to condition a latent diffusion model is to add additional embeddings (or residuals) from the conditioning signal to specific blocks of the model, directly in the perspective of the generated image.
When conditioning embeddings are not image-level signals ( e.g . text, object poses [ 70 ] , etc.), they are incorporated using cross-attention layers where the image embeddings cross-attend to the conditioning embeddings.
Since satellite images are very different from the street-level image perspective, a viable conditioning method would be to introduce layers for the image tokens to cross-attend to the full satellite image. For a multi-view diffusion model, each image could cross-attend to a transformed satellite image which is centered at and oriented along the corresponding camera’s axis.
blocks.zh:
限制潜在扩散模型的一个有效途径是,直接从生成的图像的角度,在模型的特定区块中添加附加嵌入(或残余).
当调制嵌入不是图像级信号(如文本,对象表示[70]等)时,它们会采用跨意向层进行整合,即图像嵌入到调制嵌入的交叉意向层.
由于卫星图像与街道级图像的视角大不相同,一种可行的调节方法将是引入图象标志层,以跨过整个卫星图像。 对于多视图传播模型来说,每个图像都可以跨过一个以相机轴为中心并沿相应轴向的变形卫星图像。

blocks.en:
We find that the multi-view diffusion model struggles to learn the conditioning signal from the full satellite image, likely as it is challenging for noisy image tokens to attend to within-view components of the satellite image.
We address this issue by introducing ray-guided cross-attention layers, inspired by similar works [ 78 , 79 ] .
Our ray-guided cross-attention (RGCA) layers restricts the cross-attention to be along the 1D ray-direction in the satellite view, allowing it to learn a conditioning signal more efficiently (Figure 3 ).
The queries in RGCA are the intermediate UNet features, along with an added embedding computed from Plucker Ray coordinates and the diffusion timestep. We find that the added Plucker and timestep embeddings are important, since the UNet features are noisy in the early diffusion stages. The architecture is shown in Figure 2 (c).
The final MLP layer that produces the RGCA embeddings is zero-initialized so as to retain the pretrained LDM’s latent prior.
We give full details of RGCA in the supplement.
blocks.zh:
我们发现,多视图传播模型在努力从整个卫星图像中学习调制信号方面有困难,因为噪音的图像符号很难处理卫星图像的内视部分。
我们通过在类似著作[78、79]的启发下,引入射线制导的交叉观察层来解决这一问题。
我们的射线制导交叉射线(RGCA)层限制了射线沿卫星视线的1D射线方向行进,使其能更有效地学习调制信号(图3)。
RGCA中的查询是中间的UNet特性,加上从Plucker Ray坐标和扩散时间阶梯计算出来的附加嵌入. 我们发现,添加的Plucker和时间步嵌入很重要,因为UNet在早期传播阶段的特性很吵. 该架构见图2(c)。
最后产生 RGCA 嵌入式的 MLP 层是零初始化的,以便保留预先训练过的 LDM 的潜在前端 。
我们在补编中详细介绍了皇家陆军。

blocks.en: 3.4 Training
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训

blocks.en: Our model is trained with an L2-loss on the predicted ϵ \epsilon noise. We apply this loss only to target views.
blocks.zh: 我们的模型在预言的 \\ epsilon 噪音上用L2损失来训练。 我们只将损失用于目标观点。

blocks.en: We use multiple training datasets that contain geotagged multi-view / panoramic images. These include self-driving datasets with GPS measurements, and geotagged street-view panoramas. In particular, we use nuScenes [ 6 ] , Argoverse-v2 [ 67 ] , Metropolis [ 44 ] , and VIGOR [ 84 ] . For each training sample, we sample crops from different views of multi-camera rigs in [ 6 , 67 , 44 ] and from the same panorama in VIGOR. Additionally, we identify pairs of panoramas that are within 20m in VIGOR, and sample views from both panoramas, introducing a camera baseline to reduce scene scale ambiguity. To retain the ability of the multi-view diffusion model to be conditioned on non-driving camera trajectories, we additionally train on training set of DL3DV-10K [ 41 ] dataset (excluding Benchmark scenes) without any satellite conditioning.
blocks.zh: 我们使用包含地理标记的多视图/全景图像的多个训练数据集. 其中包括带有GPS测量的自驾数据集,以及地理标记的街景全景. 特别是,我们使用nuScens [6],Argoverse-v2 [67],大都会 [44],和VIGOR [84]. 对于每个训练样本,我们从[6,67,44]对多相机钻机的不同观点和VIGOR的同一全景对作物进行取样. 此外,我们找出在VIGOR20米范围内的一对全景图,以及两个全景图的样本视图,引入一个摄像头基线,以减少场景尺度模糊. 为了保留多景传播模型以非驾驶相机轨迹为条件的能力,我们额外培训了DL3DV-10K[41]数据集(不包括基准场景)的训练集,没有任何卫星调节.

blocks.en: For our training datasets, we compile satellite imagery from various sources (details are provided in the supplementary material). For each multi-view image sample, we crop the satellite images with the center as the center of all cameras, and oriented along north. We used crops of 128m × \times 128m in size, with 4 pixels per meter.
blocks.zh: 关于我们的培训数据集,我们汇编了各种来源的卫星图像(详情见补充材料)。 对于每一个多视图图像样本,我们用中间作为所有摄像头的中心来裁剪卫星图像,并沿着北面的方向拍摄。 我们使用的作物大小为128m×\times 128m,每米有4像素.

blocks.en: We add our satellite-conditioning blocks to the SEVA model and train only the satellite-conditioning blocks, keeping the SEVA multi-view diffusion weights frozen. We train on multi-view examples with 21 views, with number of input views sampled randomly from 1 to 8. We train with the Adam optimizer on 16 × 16\times A100 GPUs. We use a learning rate of 3e-5 and a batch size of 192. For our ray-guided cross-attention, we sample 20 points along each ray starting from a minimum distance of 0.5m up to a maximum distance of 62m in the satellite image. We use 1000 diffusion timesteps during training and 50 DDIM steps [ 62 ] at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们在SEVA模型中加入了我们的卫星空调区块,并且只培训卫星空调区块,使得SEVA的多视传播重量保持了冻结. 我们用21个视图对多视图实例进行培训,随机抽取1至8个输入视图。 我们用亚当的优化器训练 16x16\Times A100GPU。 我们使用3e-5的学习率和192的批量大小. 对于我们的射线制导交叉射线,我们在卫星图像中从最小距离0.5米到最大距离62米的每个射线上取样20个点。 我们在训练中使用1000个传播时间步和50个DDIM步骤[62]推论.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: Our experiments evaluate the quality of our satellite-conditioned novel view generations on outdoor datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验评估了 我们的卫星条件小说世代 在户外数据集的质量。

blocks.en:
While several works address satellite-conditioned street-view generation or multi-view/video generation in isolation, our work is unique in combining both these areas. We compare to baselines from both families for the multi-view novel-view synthesis (NVS) task. For multi-view diffusion models, we compare to the state-of-the-art SEVA [ 3 ] . As our model adopts their backbone, we find SEVA to be the closest point of comparison, as pretraining determines NVS quality to a great extent.
Among models that only use satellite-conditioning, we compare to Sat2Density [ 50 ] , which is one of the very few publicly-available models, see Table 1 .
blocks.zh:
虽然有几部作品涉及卫星条件的街景生成或孤立的多景/视频生成,但我们的工作在将这两个领域结合起来方面是独一无二的。 我们比较了两个家庭的基线,用于多视图小说-观点综合(NVS)任务. 对于多景传播模型,我们比较最先进的SEVA[3]. 由于我们的模型采用了它们的骨干,我们发现SEVA是最接近的比较点,因为预先训练在很大程度上决定了NVS的质量.
在只使用卫星空调的模型中,我们比较了Sat2Density[50],这是极少数公开使用的模型之一,见表1。

blocks.en: We evaluate our model on validation / test splits of Metropolis [ 44 ] (36 scenes) and nuScenes [ 6 ] (150 scenes). nuScenes is a self-driving dataset with a 6-camera rig: front, front-left, front-right, back, back-left, back-right. We use 7 7 front camera views as input, collected in a sequence at equal time intervals. The 35 35 views from the other five cameras are used as targets. Metropolis contains a 3-camera rig facing forward, left, and right. We use the forward-facing camera as input and left and right facing cameras as target. This configuration allows us to evaluate target views with very little overlap with input views. These datasets are in-distribution with our training data.
blocks.zh: 我们评价我们的模型 验证/测试分割 大都会 [44] (36幕)和nuScens [6] (150幕). nuScens是一款自驾数据集,采用6相机钻机:前,前左,前右,后左,后右. 我们使用7 7 前摄像头的视图作为输入, 以相同时间间隔的顺序收集。 其他5个摄像机的35个35个视图被用作目标。 大都会有个三摄像头的钻机 正对着前面 左边和右边 我们用前视相机作为输入器 左对面和右对面相机作为目标 这种配置使我们能够评价目标视图,与输入视图几乎没有重叠. 这些数据集与我们的培训数据是分布在一起的。

blocks.en:
As an out-of-distribution generalization experiment, we evaluate on outdoor scenes from the well-established DL3DV benchmark [ 41 ] .
The original benchmark is not geo-registered; we use the geo-alignment of [ 64 ] . We use the same input-target splits from SEVA [ 3 ] : target frames are equally spaced along the trajectory (every 8th frame) and input frames are chosen by applying K-medoids clustering to the camera poses of the remaining frames. Despite this, the input-target overlap in DL3DV is substantially higher than that of our in-distribution evaluation datasets, leaving less room for improvement using satellite images.
blocks.zh:
作为分配外的通用实验,我们从既定的DL3DV基准[41]在户外场景上进行评估.
原始基准没有地理登记;我们使用[64]的地理对齐. 我们使用SEVA [3] 中相同的输入-目标分割:目标帧沿轨迹(每个8帧)均匀间隔,通过将K-medoids集群到剩余帧的相机姿势中来选择输入帧. 尽管如此,DL3DV的输入-目标重叠率远远高于我们的分布式评价数据集,因此利用卫星图像改进的余地较小。

blocks.en: Following standard practice in novel-view synthesis [ 3 ] we evaluate generation quality for the target views (PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS). Since we focus on satellite-guided controllability in unseen regions, we evaluate the adherence of the generated images to the satellite layout. We compute the semantic masks for roads and buildings using [ 7 ] , and report their semantic IoU . This serves as a good metric for layout alignment, since obtaining vectorized layout annotations for our data or generations is non-trivial. We also report the semantic similarity of predictions using features from foundational semantic models as an additional layout adherence metric. In particular, we use L2 error of DINO [ 8 ] features and cosine similarity of Segment Anything [ 33 ] (SEG in tables) encoder features as proposed in [ 78 ] . We evaluate the multi-view consistency of our generated images using SIFT correspondences [ 58 ] on overlapping views. We report TSED (Thresholded Symmetric Epipolar Distance) [ 75 , 3 ] for correspondences in these views, % of consistently generated views (with at least 10 correspondences under 8 px 2 \text{px}^{2} error, and the median number of correspondences. We report the metrics on a single randomly sampled generation for each example. For a particular example, we use the same random noise sample for SEVA and our model.
blocks.zh: 遵循新视觉综合的标准做法[3],我们评价目标视图的生成质量(PSNR,SSIM,LPIPS). 由于我们侧重于在看不见的区域的卫星制导可控性,我们评价生成的图像是否符合卫星布局。 我们计算道路和建筑的语义口罩 使用[7],并报告他们的语义IoU。 这可作为布局对齐的良好衡量标准,因为获得我们的数据或世代的矢量布局说明是非三角性的。 我们还报告使用基础语义模型的特征作为附加布局坚持度度测量的预测的语义相似性. 特别是,我们使用[78]中提议的DINO [8] 特性的L2错误和任何部分[33] (SEG)编码器特性的余弦相似性。 我们利用SIFT的函文来评价我们生成的图像的多视图一致性[58] 对重叠观点的评价。 我们报告 TSED ( Threaksolded Symmetrole Epipolar trade) [75, 3] 对于这些视图中的函证,% 一致生成的函证(在 8 px 2\ text{px}^{2} 下至少有 10 个函证) 错误, 以及函证的中位数 。 我们报告每个例子的单个随机抽样生成的衡量标准。 具体来说,我们对SEVA和我们的模型使用相同的随机噪声样本.

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that Sat2Density struggles to recover street-level images from satellite imagery and an appearance code. The street-view-only SEVA baseline produces perceptually plausible target views from its learned multi-view prior, but has weaker semantic IoU, indicating a weaker semantic layout-adherence. GroundControl improves image quality and layout-adherence on both datasets. On nuScenes, our gains are primarily in PSNR, SSIM, and semantic IoU, while LPIPS and DINO remain comparable to SEVA, thus slightly improving layout adherence while preserving perceptual quality. The gains are substantially larger on Metropolis, where SEVA is much worse than on nuScenes. GroundControl improves across all metrics ( e.g . , 10.88 → \rightarrow 12.81 PSNR, 0.291 → \rightarrow 0.372 building IoU). This suggests that satellite condition is more useful when the street-view prior alone provides weaker constraints on unseen scene content.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,Sat2Density努力从卫星图像和外观代码中恢复街道层面的图像。 仅以街景为主的SEVA基线,从其先前学到的多视图中得出了有目共睹的目标观点,但具有较弱的语义IoU,表明语义布局较弱的坚持. 地面控制提高了图像质量,使两个数据集的布局都更加一致。 在nuScenes上,我们的收益主要在PSNR,SSIM,和语义IoU上,而LPIPS和DINO仍然与SEVA相当,从而在保持知觉质量的同时略微改进了布局的坚持性. 而在大都会, 地面控制在所有衡量标准上都有改进(例如,10.88 = 右转12.81 PSNR,0.291 = 右转0.372 Building IoU)。 这表明,当街景本身对未见的场景内容造成较弱的限制时,卫星条件就更有用。

blocks.en: On DL3DV (Table 3 ), GroundControl generalizes well despite being trained only on driving datasets. It improves PSNR and SSIM, while remaining comparable to SEVA in LPIPS, SEG, and DINO. Satellite conditioning also improves multi-view consistency, reducing TSED and increasing the fraction of consistent views. Since DL3DV has much higher overlap between input and target views than Metropolis or nuScenes, there is less room for satellite conditioning to help. Sat2Density however performs substantially worse, highlighting the difficulty of generating these views from satellite imagery alone. Overall, these results suggest that satellite conditioning can improve generation quality and multi-view consistency even outside our training distribution.
blocks.zh: 在DL3DV(表3)上,地面控制虽然只接受了驾驶数据集的培训,但还是得到了很好的概括。 它改进了PSNR和SSIM,同时在LPIPS,SEG,和DINO中仍然与SEVA相当. 卫星调制还提高了多视图的一致性,减少了TSED,增加了一致视图的分数. 由于DL3DV与大都会或nuScenes相比,输入与目标视图的重叠程度要高得多,因此卫星调制帮助空间较小. 然而,Sat2D敏感度的表现却严重恶化,突出表明了仅从卫星图像中得出这些观点的困难。 总的来说,这些结果表明,卫星调节即使在我们的培训分配之外也能提高发电质量和多视图一致性。

blocks.en: 4.1 Ablations
blocks.zh: 4.1 违约

blocks.en: We ablate some of the key design choices of our method on the Metropolis dataset in Table 4 . We provide more qualitative comparisons and ablation details in the supplement.
blocks.zh: 我们在表4的大都会数据集中放弃了我们方法的一些关键设计选择。 我们在补编中提供了更多的质量比较和细节。

blocks.en: Without ray-guided cross-attention (RGCA). An alternative to using ray-guidance during cross-attention is for each street-image token to attend to all satellite tokens. We find that given our dataset size, this baseline struggles to leverage the satellite image for the novel-view synthesis, as evidenced by the lower performance in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 无射线导交叉射线(RGCA). 在交叉观察时使用射线指导的一种替代办法是,每个街景标志物都注意所有卫星标志物。 我们发现,鉴于我们数据集的大小,这一基线在利用卫星图象进行小说-观点综合方面挣扎不已,表4中表现较低就证明了这一点。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Ablation study on the Metropolis dataset.
blocks.zh: 表4:大都会数据集的读取研究.

blocks.en: We find that adding the satellite cross-attention layers in the UNet encoder performs better than in the decoder.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,在UNet编码器中添加卫星横切层比在解码器中做得更好。

blocks.en: We add a raymap and diffusion timestep embedding to the queries in all RGCA layers (Fig. 2 ). We find that this is important, as queries are otherwise noisy, especially early in the diffusion process.
blocks.zh: 我们在所有RGCA层(图2)的查询中添加一个射线图和传播时间步。 我们认为,这一点很重要,因为除此之外,查询是吵闹的,特别是在传播过程的早期阶段。

blocks.en: We consider a conditioning design that leverages the same multi-view diffusion model for the satellite images. We provide the satellite image as another input view, with a learned embedding for the plucker ray input that SEVA requires. This is comparable to methods in related work [ 65 ] . It re-uses the pretrained diffusion model to encode satellite images, and the information between satellite and ground views transfers through the cross-view attention layers in SEVA. We finetune the self- and cross-view layers. As reported in Table 4 , we find that this does not condition the generation as expected. This can be explained by the lack of specialized learned modules to process satellite images, as they are significantly different from ground view images captured by consumer cameras.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑一种条件设计,利用同样的多视图传播模型来传播卫星图像。 我们提供卫星图象作为另一个输入视图,为SEVA所需要的提取射线输入提供一个学习的嵌入. 这与相关工作的方法相当[65]。 它重新使用经过预先训练的传播模型来编码卫星图像,卫星和地面观测之间的信息通过SEVA中的交叉观测关注层转移. 我们调整了自我和交叉视图层。 如表4所示,我们发现这并没有像预期的那样对一代人造成限制。 其原因是缺乏专门化的学习模块来处理卫星图像,因为这些模块与消费者摄像机拍摄的地面观测图像大不相同。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We have introduced GroundControl, which enables effective satellite conditioning of multi-view diffusion models.
Our architectural innovations ensure the satellite image is incorporated efficiently and effectively.
Our extensive evaluations on public benchmark datasets validate the utility of our contributions and set a new state-of-the-art for free-viewpoint satellite-conditioned novel-view synthesis.
blocks.zh:
我们实行了地面控制,从而能够有效地对多景传播模型进行卫星调节。
我们的建筑创新确保了卫星图象得到高效率和高效益的纳入。
我们对公共基准数据集的广泛评价验证了我们贡献的效用,并为自由视点卫星条件的新新视角综合设定了最新技术。

blocks.en: A.1 Performance across different input-target view overlap levels
blocks.zh: A.1 不同输入-目标视图重叠水平的业绩

blocks.en: In this section we compare the interpolation vs extrapolation capabilities of our model. So, we evaluate how our model’s performance varies across different levels of overlap between input and target views. We use 20 scenes from Metropolis, and sample 20 different input-target view configurations for each scene at random. For each configuration, we compute the maximum number of SIFT correspondences for each target view across all input views. This indicates the maximum amount of visual overlap for that target view. We plot the PSNR for the target views bucketed by this indicator of visual overlap in Figure I . We find that our model provides improvements across all levels of visual overlap. The improvement in the low-overlap region ( < 200 <200 correspondences) is noticeably consistent.
blocks.zh: 我们在本节中比较了我们的模型的内插和外推能力。 因此,我们评价我们模型的性能如何在投入与目标观点的重叠程度上有所不同。 我们使用来自大都会的20场景,随机抽取20个不同的输入-目标视图配置. 对于每个配置,我们计算所有输入视图中每个目标视图的SIFT对应的最大数量. 这表明该目标视图的最大视觉重叠量。 我们为图一中的视觉重叠指标所标注的目标视图绘制了PSNR。 我们发现,我们的模型在视觉重叠的各个层面提供了改进。 低重叠区域( < 200 < 200份信函)的改善明显一致。

blocks.en: Figure I: PSNR performance vs. image overlap measured by the number of correspondences on Metropolis dataset . GroundControl obtains better performance compared to the SEVA baseline across all overlap regimes.
blocks.zh: 图一:PSNR性能与大都会数据集函证数量测量的图像重叠 . 与所有重叠制度的SEVA基线相比,地面控制得到更好的性能。

blocks.en: A.2 Robustness to satellite pose misalignment
blocks.zh: A.2 卫星的强力构成错位

blocks.en: Our method assumes that the transformation from the reference frame used in the diffusion model to the satellite image is known. In practice, this geo-alignment can be achieved using methods like OrienterNet [ 57 ] . To benchmark on this more practical setting, we introduce random pose offsets in our satellite alignment for nuScenes and DL3DV in Table I . We add random translation and rotation offsets to the alignment (upto 10m translation, 10 ​ ° 10\degree rotation offset). OrienterNet falls within this range (99.5% recall < < 5m, 5 ​ ° 5\degree ). GroundControl performance only suffers very little degradation in this range, and remains competitive with SEVA with improvements in PSNR/SSIM.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法假设,从扩散模型所用的参照框架到卫星图像的转变是众所周知的。 在实际操作中,这种地理对接可以通过OrienterNet等方法实现[57]. 为了以这一更实际的设定为基准,我们在表一的卫星对准nuScenes和DL3DV时采用了随机姿势抵消。 我们在对齐中加入随机翻译和旋转抵消(最多10m翻译,10°10′旋转抵消). OrienterNet属于这一范围(99.5%召回 < 5m, 5° 5° 度)。 地面控制性能在这一范围内只受到很少的退化,在PSNR/SSIM的改进下,与SEVA保持竞争力.

blocks.en: A.3 Additional baselines
blocks.zh: A.3 其他基线

blocks.en: In the main paper, we use Sat2Density as our satellite conditioned street view generation baseline. Although it mainly relies on the satellite image, it also uses the input street-level views to compute a global appearance embedding that contains lighting information, which the generation model is conditioned on. For our novel-view synthesis diffusion baseline, we primarily compare to SEVA [ 3 ] . Since GroundControl is built on top of SEVA, it is comparable in terms of number of parameters and pretraining data. Here we discuss comparisons to more novel-view synthesis baselines. We also discuss comparisons to video generation models.
blocks.zh: 在主要论文中,我们使用Sat2Density作为卫星条件的街景生成基线. 尽管它主要依靠卫星图像,但它也利用输入街级视图来计算一个包含照明信息的全球外观嵌入,而生成模型则以此信息为条件. 对于我们的新颖观点综合传播基线,我们主要比较SEVA[3]. 由于地面控制是建立在SEVA之上的,在参数数量和预训数据方面是可比较的. 在这里,我们讨论比较更多的新颖视角综合基线。 我们还讨论了与视频生成模型的比较。

blocks.en: A.3.1 Video generation models
blocks.zh: A.3.1 视频生成模型

blocks.en: Vanilla image-to-video (I2V) diffusion models are ill-suited for novel-view synthesis (NVS) as they cannot generate specific target viewpoints. Even when finetuned for camera conditioning, the target frames are required to form a continuous trajectory, which is incompatible with our task of predicting arbitrary viewpoints. They are also trained with only 1 or 2 input-view conditioning. Our task involves multiple input views. We make a best-effort comparison of our model to some video generation models as described below.
blocks.zh: 香草图像到视频(I2V)的传播模型不适合小说-视觉合成(NVS),因为它们不能产生特定的目标观点. 即使在为相机调制而微调时,目标帧也需要形成连续的轨迹,这与我们预测任意观点的任务不符. 他们也只接受了1或2个输入视图条件的培训。 我们的任务涉及多种投入观点。 我们将我们的模型与下文所述的一些视频生成模型进行最佳的比较。

blocks.en: We compared against the ViewCrafter [ 77 ] baseline in Table 3 of our paper. It uses a video diffusion model for novel-view synthesis by conditioning it on partial scene point clouds, obtained from a sparse set of input views. It also assumes that the frames to be generated sequentially follow the first frame (input). We therefore provide it an additional view, in the form of the first target view. This makes the comparison unfair (in ViewCrafter’s favor). We use the 4 views to construct the point cloud. We then render the point cloud for 25 test views and use the diffusion model to generate the corresponding frames conditioned on these renders. As the model can only generate 25 frames at a time, and our splits have about 40 target views, we repeat this process for subsequent frames. When a set of frames has fewer than 25 test views, we duplicate the last test frame as needed so that we always generate a full set of 25 frames. Despite this, both SEVA and our model significantly outperform ViewCrafter in Table 3 (main paper).
blocks.zh: 我们比较了文件表3中的viewCrrefter[77]基线。 它通过在部分场景点云上进行调制,使用视频传播模型来进行小说-视觉合成,这是从一组稀少的输入视图中获得的. 它还假设要生成的帧会依次遵循第一个帧(输入). 因此,我们以第一个目标观点的形式提供了另一个观点。 这样比较就不公平(在 ViewCrafter 中) 。 我们用四个观点来构建点云. 然后,我们制作25个测试视图的点云,并利用扩散模型生成以这些成像为条件的相应框架。 由于该模型每次只能生成25帧,而我们的拆分有约40个目标视图,我们重复这个过程用于后续帧. 当一组帧的测试视图少于25个时,我们根据需要重复了最后一个测试帧,这样我们总是产生一组完整的25个帧. 尽管如此,SEVA和我们的模型在表3(主要论文)中都大大超过了VideoCrafter。

blocks.en: To compare against the more recent video models, e.g . RealCamI2V [ 36 ] and Veo 3.1 (proprietary), we created a 1-view (first frame as input) and 2-view (first and last frames as input) sequential input-target split on Metropolis in Tab. II . This is a specialization of the more general novel-view synthesis task that restricts the target views to a continuous trajectory. We further divide this into straight and turning trajectories to analyze model performances separately in the two cases. RealCamI2V is a camera-controlled video model that can be conditioned on a single input frame only. Even on this video generation task, we are slightly better than RealCamI2V (noticeably better on PSNR, while being slightly worse on DINO and segment-anything feature similarity). We also compare against the proprietary Veo model on a subset of Metropolis with 2 input views (Veo supports a start and end frame conditioning). blocks.en: A.3.2 Feedforward Regression Models

blocks.en: In our evaluation we exclude baselines which are trained for the task of reconstruction, rather than generation. This is because our task focuses on synthesizing accurate content in regions which are not visible in the input views using information from the satellite view. Comparing to models which do not even attempt to generate such content is unfair to those models and uninformative to the performance on our desired task. In Fig. X , we illustrate this with an example output from LongLRM [ 85 ] on a scene from our 3-view DL3DV test split. We repeat our 3 input views so that LongLRM gets 32 input views total, and run inference at its native resolution, both of which favor its performance. LongLRM does not perform well because much of the target view is not visible in the input views at all (resulting in much of the target view being blank), and the highly extrapolative nature of the task means that visible areas of the scene also do not look good. For this reason we do not consider feedforward reconstruction models such as LongLRM to be suitable baselines for our task.
blocks.zh: 在我们的评估中,我们排除了为重建任务而训练的基线,而不是世代。 这是因为我们的任务是利用卫星观测到的信息,在输入视图中看不到的区域合成准确的内容。 与甚至不试图产生这种内容的模型相比,是对这些模型的不公平的,而且对我们所期望的任务的绩效也无益。 以法义. X,我们用LongLRM[85]的示例输出来说明这一点,一个场景来自我们三景的DL3DV测试分裂. 我们重复我们的3个输入视图,让LongLRM得到总共32个输入视图,并运行推论它的原生分辨率,两者都有利于它的性能. 长 LRM的性能不佳,因为很多目标视图在输入视图中完全不明显(导致许多目标视图是空白的),任务高度外推性质意味着场景的可见区域看起来也不好. 因此,我们不认为LongLRM等向前进的重建模式是适合我们任务的基线。

blocks.en: To better quantify our model’s performance compared to SEVA (no satellite conditioning), we further analyze the metrics in Table 2 (main paper). For each scene, we compute δ = ( PSNR ours − PSNR SEVA ) \delta=(\text{PSNR}_{\text{ours}}-\text{PSNR}_{\text{SEVA}}) , the improvement in PSNR for our generation vs SEVA. We tabulate the percentile distribution for this metric in Table III . Satellite helps in all cases on Metropolis (lowest value of δ \delta is positive). On nuScenes, our model is noticeably worse ( > > 0.5 dB) for only 3.7 % scenes. We found 2 common challenges in these cases on nuScenes: a) A large vehicle (truck / tram) occludes most of the input FOV, or b) the camera is stationary ( e.g . while waiting at intersections). Both these cases give GroundControl very little ground-level context, which it needs to fuse information from satellite view.

blocks.en: We also performed another experiment on misaligned satellite images. Instead of the correct satellite image, we provided different images with 2 types of misalignments (i) by flipping the satellite image horizontally, and (ii) by using a mismatched satellite image from another random scene. We performed this analysis on Metropolis and report the results in Table IV . These corruptions indeed degrade generation quality. However, the degradation is not too significant. This is likely because many scene layouts in driving datasets are similar (even under the flip transformation). Moreover, the input image condition provides a strong prior that the model does not violate even with a misaligned satellite image (it prefers the street image signals, under a conflicting satellite signal).
blocks.zh: 我们还对误联的卫星图像进行了另一次试验。 我们提供了两种类型的错配图像,而不是正确的卫星图像(一) 横向翻转卫星图像,以及(二) 从另一个随机场景使用不匹配的卫星图像。 我们在大都会进行了这一分析,并在表四中报告了分析结果。 这些腐败确实降低了发电质量。 然而,退化程度并不大。 这可能是因为驱动数据集中的许多场景布局类似(甚至在翻转转换下). 此外,输入图像条件还提供了一个很强的先验条件,即该模型即使有错配的卫星图像也不违反(它更喜欢街道图像信号,在相互冲突的卫星信号下).

blocks.en: B.2 Effect of Dual CFG
blocks.zh: B.2 双重CFG的效果

blocks.en: As discussed in the main paper, we use a dual-CFG scheme which allows us to separately control the strength of the conditioning on the input views and on the satellite image. In Fig. VI we show the impact of varying the satellite CFG value while keeping the image CFG value fixed (something made possible by our dual-CFG approach). As we increase the satellite CFG, the model correctly extends the monorail and the lane divider, and removes the building in the background, in accordance with the satellite image. However at very high values, the quality of the generated image begins to decrease. Our dual-CFG approach gives control over this tradeoff. (Note that at satellite CFG 0 the output is independent of the content of the satellite image, because the satellite guidance term from eq. 1 of the main submission gets multiplied by zero.)
blocks.zh: 如主要论文所述,我们采用双重CFG计划,使我们能够在输入视图和卫星图像上分别控制条件强度。 以法义. 六. 我们显示改变卫星CFG值的影响,同时保持图像CFG值的固定(通过我们的双CFG方法可以实现这一点)。 在我们增加卫星CFG时,模型正确地延伸了单轨和车道分割器,并按照卫星图像将建筑从背景中移除. 然而在极高的数值下,生成的图像的质量开始下降. 我们的双重CFG方法控制了这种权衡。 (注意在CFG 0号卫星上,输出量独立于卫星图像的内容,因为从主要提交的eq.1中得出的卫星指导术语乘以0。 )

blocks.en: We found that training our satellite conditioning parameters on relatively small datasets ( e.g . Argoverse or VIGOR alone) can cause them to overfit to the camera trajectory distributions on these datasets. Most of our datasets use a multi-view inside-out facing camera rig with straight-line motion (or no motion in case of panoramas). The model on these alone does not generalize to other scenes with handheld cameras. For this reason, we add data that is closer to the training distribution of SEVA to retain its performance beyond our training dataset. We include scenes from DL3DV [ 41 ] with the benchmark scenes removed during training. For these scenes, we do not use any satellite encoder features (the conditioning layers get a zero-input). blocks.en: D.1 Ray-guided Cross Attention
blocks.zh: D.1 光导交叉注意

blocks.en:
We insert our ray-guided satellite cross attention block after the intra-view self-attention and inter-view self-attention blocks in SEVA.
The satellite-conditioned cross attention block primarily contains a satellite cross-attention layer and an MLP, both of which are applied in a residual manner [ 23 ] to the diffusion embeddings that are input to the block.

我们在SEVA的内视自觉和内视自觉区块之后插入我们的射线导卫星交叉注意力区块.
卫星条件的交叉注意力区块主要包含一个卫星交叉注意力层和一个MLP,两者都以剩余的方式[23]应用于作为该块输入的传播嵌入.

blocks.en:
Each such block receives four inputs: • multi-view diffusion embeddings I I :
These are the intermediate SEVA features at that block. The number of channels and resolution varies throughout the model. • Ray embeddings R R :
The Plucker coordinates for the 3D ray direction, which does not include the yaw component i.e . is computed using the rotation matrix with the yaw removed.
These ray coordinates are passed to an MLP to encode to a fixed dimension. • The diffusion timestep embedding t t :
This diffusion timestep t t is passed to an MLP to encode to a fixed dimension. • Satellite feature samples S S :
20 samples along each street image ray, with 1D position embedding added along each ray.
These samples are evenly spaced between the camera origin and a maximum depth of 62m. Note that the ray embedding MLP and diffusion timestep MLP are shared across different satellite conditioning blocks. These are added to the UNet’s intermediate features to obtain the cross-attention queries. In our ablations, we find that it is important to use these embeddings, as the UNet intermediate features are very noisy in the early diffusion process. Since the satellite image is top-down, all patches along a particular column of the street-image attend to the same ray along the satellite image (assuming images are approximately gravity-aligned). The raymap embeddings in the attention query can therefore, help tokens from the same column attend to different satellite image tokens.

blocks.en: The ray-guided cross-attention is different from a vanilla cross attention in that each image token selectively attends to the satellite tokens along its 3D ray, as opposed to attending to the whole satellite image. This efficient mechanism enables us to condition a large multi-view diffusion on satellite information by training the added satellite-conditioning layers on the relatively small easily accessible paired image-satellite datasets.
blocks.zh: 射线制导的交叉视线与香草式的交叉视线不同,因为每个图像符号有选择地关注其3D射线沿线的卫星符号,而不是关注整个卫星图像. 这种高效的机制使我们能够通过在相对较小的易于获取的对映卫星数据集上培训增加的卫星空调层,对卫星信息进行大规模多视图传播。

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: Overall, our approach for improving NVS is only suitable for use in GPS-localized outside locations. We build our satellite-conditioned model on top of an existing multi-view diffusion model (SEVA [ 3 ] ). SEVA uses an entangled camera pose and appearance representation (by concatenating raymaps and images) which means that any modifications to its embeddings can affect either appearance or poses. When used on datasets with camera trajectories that are completely out-of-distribution, we notice that satellite conditioning can affect the multi-view consistency (pose conditioning) or appearance (saturation or image quality) of the generated images. Our training minimizes this by balancing various different datasets. We also notice that in many cases the satellite conditioning can induce an incorrect generation by being sensitive to shadows of buildings that are visible in the satellite image. Unsurprisingly, our model can also struggle when the images are captured in covered areas, e.g . under a bridge, under tree canopies, parking lots, etc. If there have been large changes in the scene since the satellite view was captured, e.g . buildings have been built or demolished, then performance may degrade.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,我们改进NVS的方法仅适合用于全球定位系统本地化的外部地点。 我们在现有多景传播模型(SEVA[3])的基础上建造了卫星条件模型。 SEVA使用缠绕的相机姿势和外观表现(通过折叠射线图和图像),这意味着对其嵌入的任何修改都可能影响外观或姿势. 当用在有完全不分布的相机轨迹的数据集上时,我们注意到卫星调制会影响生成的图像的多视图一致性(pose contention)或外观(饱和度或图像质量). 我们的训练通过平衡各种不同的数据集来尽量减少这种情况。 我们还注意到,在许多情况下,卫星空调对卫星图像中可见的建筑物的阴影敏感,可诱发错误的生成。 毫不奇怪,当图像被捕获到被覆盖的地区时,我们的模型也可以挣扎,比如在桥下,树冠下,停车场等. 如果自卫星观测被俘后现场发生了巨大变化,例如建筑物已经建造或拆除,那么性能可能会退化.

blocks.en: Appendix F Future work
blocks.zh: 附录F 今后的工作

blocks.en: Our work can be revisited with emerging DiT-based diffusion models, which are more flexible than UNet-based models. Currently, our model does not use any viewpoint metadata available for satellite images. Incorporating overhead viewpoint information this could allow joint conditioning on satellite and oblique aerial images. Incorporating vectorized semantic map conditioning is also an exciting direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作可以重新审视新出现的基于DiT的传播模式,这些模式比基于UNet的模式更加灵活。 目前,我们的模型没有使用卫星图像可用的任何观点元数据。 纳入俯视信息可以使卫星和斜面航空图像具有联合条件。 纳入矢量化的语义图调也是未来工作的令人振奋的方向.
